description: This file contains an implementation of a live command for deleting a feature definition, specifically the class DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl which is a final immutable class that extends an abstract modify live command and implements DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand. It provides methods to create instances, retrieve feature ID, category, and to set headers, among others.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable concrete implementation of the DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand, providing mechanisms to create, manage, and modify delete feature definition commands in a live signal context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to DeleteFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization, returning false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for creating answers to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides toString to include class name and the superclass's string representation.
